title: Q-RES-second-loop-2026-S4: Papers the code does not live up to (measured 0.6, target >= 1.0)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: second-loop-2026 finding S4 is not-met (measured 0.6)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe second-loop-2026:S4
**Prediction:** research_findings_met_share >= 1.0 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe second-loop-2026:S4`
**Status:** open

Concern: Papers the code does not live up to. The study: Each finding in each paper names its mechanism and the measurement that tests it. The share that meets its target is an essential variable, so a paper that drifts from the code pushes the slow loop to build, not to edit the paper.

Mechanisms that should answer it: RESEARCH-LOOP-1 (foundation/research.py); RESEARCH-LOOP-1 (doctrine/ultrastability.json).

Metric: share of every finding in every paper whose own measurement meets its target, excluding this metric (RESEARCH-LOOP-1), target >= 1.0. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
